name: Ernest Kleinwort Charitable Trust medium grants (conservation)
summary: Medium-sized grants, open in four windows a year, for UK-registered charities running scalable UK or international projects that directly address threats to endangered plants or animals.
reporting: Funded charities complete a project report when the Trust requests it.

calls.label: Four windows a year
calls.recurring: 4 January to 4 February, 18 April to 12 May, 10 July to 13 August, and 9 October to 12 November

status.quote: Medium and large grant applications are only open within specific date ranges during the year as outlined below.

recurring.quote: Applications accepted online four times a year during the following date ranges: 4th January - 4th February 18th April - 12th May 10th July - 13th August 9th October - 12th November

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must be organisations registered with one year of filed accounts with the Charity Commission in England & Wales or Office of the Scottish Charity Register in Scotland.

geography.quote: UK & International based wildlife & environmental conservation projects - scalable projects which directly address threats to endangered flora or fauna.

access.quote: Applications by post or email are not accepted. Please use the on-line application forms.

reporting.quote: After you have received funding you will be asked to complete a project report.

window.quote: Large and Medium Grant applications are only accepted during the dates shown on the 'Application Forms' page, applications outside of these periods are not accepted.
